data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-k-n', which means 'to move, shift, or migrate'. The name Neekan signifies gracefulness and elegance, evoking images of gentle movement and fluidity. In Islamic history, this name is associated with the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his migration from Mecca to Medina. The name Neekan carries the meaning “Graceful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Neekan usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
